en.headline: Transport Department to accept ride-hailing driver permit applications from Monday
en.dek: Applications open at 10am on 30 November via the GovHK portal using iAM Smart; there is no quota.
body: Transport Commissioner Angela Ng said the department would begin accepting applications for ride-hailing vehicle driver permits from 10am next Monday. The permits, often called person licences, have no upper limit and applications will be accepted year-round on a non-first-come basis.

Applicants must be at least 21 years old, hold a full private car or light goods vehicle driving licence for at least one year, have no serious traffic conviction records, pass a combined written test for taxis and ride-hailing, and complete a pre-service course for drivers. Applications are submitted online through a dedicated page on the Hong Kong Government one-stop portal using iAM Smart, with identity documents uploaded and fees paid electronically. Successful applicants will receive an electronic permit via the e-driving licence mini-programme.

Ng added that those who have already passed the written test or held a private car for a period before the regulatory regime takes effect will receive higher chances in the later draw for vehicle permits, which the department expects to open early next year. Eight applications for ride-hailing service platform licences were received by the October deadline.

zh.headline: 運輸署下周一上午10時接受網約車駕駛許可證申請
zh.dek: 申請透過智方便在一站通專頁提交，並無配額上限，非先到先得。
body: 運輸署署長謝詠誼表示，署方將於下周一上午10時起接受網約車車輛駕駛許可證申請。該許可證並無配額上限，全年均可申請，且非先到先得。
申請人須年滿21歲，持有私家車或輕型貨車正式駕駛執照至少一年，沒有嚴重交通違規定罪紀錄，通過的士及網約車綜合筆試，並完成網約車司機職前課程。申請人可透過香港政府一站通專頁，利用智方便登入後上載身分證明文件、提供電子聯絡資料並繳費。成功申請者將透過電子駕駛執照小程式獲發電子許可證。
謝詠誼補充，已通過綜合筆試或在規管制度生效前一段時間已擁有私家車的人士，在其後車輛許可證抽籤時可獲額外中籤機會。運輸署預計明年初公開接受車輛許可證申請。網約車服務牌照申請期已於上月底結束，共收到八份申請。
